context.person: A person using an online ticket checkout
context.journey_stage: Checkout control needs an accessible label
context.user_goal: Name the action and resulting total change before payment.

product_state.preceding_state: An icon-only control removes an applied discount, but assistive technology announces only 'button'.
product_state.current_state: The control removes the student discount. Removing the discount increases the total by $12.
known_facts: The control removes the student discount.
Removing the discount increases the total by $12.
The discount can be added again before payment.
No purchase occurs when the control is activated.
forbidden_claims: The icon alone provides an accessible name.

current_content.heading: Something went wrong
current_content.body: Review the latest information and continue.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product banner so the person can understand checkout control needs an accessible label, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Provide a control label that names the discount and removal effect.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: An unlabeled control hides a material price change from screen-reader users.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Name the action and resulting total change before payment.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
